title: Agent experience and agent-led growth: a chat with Caelean Barnes
summary: Gauge CEO Caelean Barnes joins Dev Talks to explain how coding agents pick developer tools, why docs sway their choices, and how to test what agents do.

# Agent experience and agent-led growth: a chat with Caelean Barnes


By[Joshua Alphonse](https://www.mux.com/team/joshua-alphonse) • 28 min read •[Customers](https://www.mux.com/blog/category/customers)


---


We sit down with Caelean Barnes, Co-founder and CEO of Gauge, to talk about how coding agents choose the tools they build with. Gauge runs agents like Claude Code and Codex in sandboxes and watches what they read, what they pick, and where they get stuck. Caelean also explains why they replaced their YouTube embeds with Mux and what’s coming next, including an open source version of Gauge.


Watch in the player above, or read the transcript below.
